text: **dsh-md-html-render**（DSH 插件，任意客户端）：将 Markdown 文本渲染为带样式的独立 HTML 网页。它在 DSH Host 注册模型工具 `md_html_render`，可返回完整 HTML 字符串，也可在提供保存路径时通过 DSH 文件服务写入磁盘。渲染内容包括标题、段落、列表、代码块、表格、引用、链接和图片，适合把计划、报告或文档转换成可在浏览器打开的页面。无需 API 密钥；保存文件时需要 DSH `fs` 服务。

**dsh-md-html-render** (DSH plugin): The `md_html_render` tool turns Markdown into a styled standalone HTML page, returns the HTML, and can save it through DSH `fs`. It supports common document elements such as lists, code blocks, and tables. No API key is needed.
想把 Markdown 文档转换成可以直接在浏览器打开的 HTML 页面。
能不能让 DSH 把生成的报告渲染成带样式的网页并保存到指定路径？
I need a DSH tool that turns Markdown notes into a complete standalone HTML document.
**dsh-md-html-render** 的功能「Markdown 转独立网页」：工具接收 Markdown、可选标题，并生成包含样式和常见排版元素的完整 HTML 文档；可直接返回 HTML，也可选填路径保存文件。

This plugin has been **merged into [`LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview`](https://github.com/LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview)**. This repository is archived and will receive no further updates.

dsh-md-html-render README · ⚠️ Deprecated — merged into [dsh-md-preview](https://github.com/LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview)：> **About the names.** Since v0.3.0 the merged plugin publishes under the package
> name **`dsh-md-html-render`** — this repository's name — because the npm name
> `dsh-md-preview` was registered on 2026-08-17 by an unrelated project from a
> different author. The repository path and the package name therefore no longer
> match. The code is at `LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview`; *this* repository is only
> the pre-merge history and is not that package. Installing `dsh-md-preview`
> from npm gets you the other author's project.

dsh-md-html-render README · Why：Two plugins in this account rendered Markdown: this one provided the model-facing `md_html_render` tool, and `dsh-md-preview` provided the web GUI preview drawer. They carried two copies of the same renderer, and those copies had drifted apart — the same document could come out differently depending on which one produced it.

They are now one plugin with one renderer behind both surfaces, with a test that fails the build if the two ever disagree again.

dsh-md-html-render README · Why：**This code also never worked as an installed package.** It called `harness.registerTool(...)`, a sandbox global that only exists for in-process dynamic plugins, so the package form could not load. The merged version uses the real `defineTool` contract and is covered by executing tests.
dsh-md-html-render README · Migrate：You get the tool in a headless profile exactly as before, plus the preview drawer if your profile has the web GUI. Two differences worth knowing:

dsh-md-html-render README · Migrate：- The tool description and generated page are now **English**, and the page no longer hardcodes `lang="zh"` or appends a generator footer. The [Chinese README](https://github.com/LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) is maintained.
- Writes resolve through the session filesystem service, so `save_path` obeys the same sandbox policy as every other write instead of bypassing it.

dsh-md-html-render README · ⚠️ 已废弃 — 已并入 [dsh-md-preview](https://github.com/LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview)：本插件已**并入 [`LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview`](https://github.com/LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview)**。此仓库已归档，不再更新。

> **关于名字。** 自 v0.3.0 起，合并后的插件以 **`dsh-md-html-render`**——也就是本仓库的名字——作为包名发布，因为
> npm 上的 `dsh-md-preview` 已于 2026-08-17 被另一位作者的无关项目注册。于是仓库路径与包名不再一致：代码在
> `LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview`，而**本仓库**尽管同名，只是合并前的历史，并不是那个包。从 npm 安装
> `dsh-md-preview` 得到的是别人的项目。

dsh-md-html-render README · 原因：本账号下曾有两个插件都在渲染 Markdown：本仓库提供模型工具 `md_html_render`，`dsh-md-preview` 提供网页界面的预览抽屉。两者各带一份渲染器副本，且已经产生漂移——同一份文档由不同入口产出，结果可能不一致。

现在它们合并为一个插件、一套渲染器支撑两个入口，并有测试保证一旦再次出现分歧就直接构建失败。

**另外，这份代码作为安装包从来就没能跑起来。** 它调用了 `harness.registerTool(...)`——这是只在进程内动态插件里才存在的沙箱全局变量，因此包形态根本无法加载。合并后的版本改用了真正的 `defineTool` 契约，并有真实执行的测试覆盖。

dsh-md-html-render README · 迁移：- 工具描述与生成页面改为**英文**，页面不再硬编码 `lang="zh"`，也不再追加生成器署名页脚。[中文 README](https://github.com/LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) 仍在维护。
- 写入统一经由会话文件服务解析，因此 `save_path` 会遵守与其他写操作相同的沙箱策略，而不再绕开它。
